description: After `client stop`, `pardner client status` (and `client list`) exit 1 with `INTERNAL_ERROR: fetch failed`, while `client stop` reports the same state calmly and a fresh directory gives CLIENT_NOT_RUNNING.
expected: `client status` answers the not-running case: CLIENT_NOT_RUNNING (or success with running:false).
suggested_fix: Use the same probe as stop/open in status/list; map unreachable to CLIENT_NOT_RUNNING.

description: `client status` returns the full /session payload (~2 KB: heads, replica IDs, API paths, suggestedIdentity) with no `running` or URL field.
expected: A top-level `running:true` and `localUrl`, with detail secondary.
actual: Running state must be inferred from success:true.
suggested_fix: Add running and localUrl to status output.

criterion: Network failure: retry option, actionable message
description: When the service stops, the board banner says "The local Pardner client did not respond. Check that it is still running, then retry." without naming how to start it, and Retry connection gives no feedback when the service is still down. New task stays enabled.
expected: "Pardner stopped on this computer. Run `pardner open` to start it, then retry." Retry shows "Still not responding"; write actions disabled while disconnected.
actual: Generic copy; silent retry; New task enabled.
suggested_fix: Name `pardner open` in the banner; give Retry a pending/failed state.
